product.name: TrustAgent
product.tagline: Catch hallucinations before your users do.
product.subhead: An open-source gateway that checks every LLM answer against the documents your app already sent, for {claim:fast_check_cost_per_1k} [estimate], and sends only the risky ones to a full LLM audit.

consent: Your key stays in this browser tab and is sent only to openrouter.ai. It is cleared after 2 hours or when you press Forget key.

Requires credits on your OpenRouter account; a typical check (about 5,000 tokens of documents) costs about {cost_per_check} [estimate], a short example less; this demo stops after {max_calls} calls to OpenRouter (checks and AI drafts).

policies.diverged_file: policies.yaml changed at {file_time} and replaced your dashboard edit from {edit_time}

warnings.no_corroborator: {check} blocks only when another signal agrees ({corroborators}), and none of them can run on this route, so it can flag answers but not block them.
warnings.no_corroborator_fix_documents: Give the route documents to check against so the instant checks can run.
warnings.no_corroborator_fix_attach: Attach {corroborators} to the route so it can confirm a block.
warnings.implies_unattached: {check} is cross-checked against {implied} to catch the two disagreeing, but this route does not run {implied}, so that cross-check never happens.
warnings.fail_closed_not_enforcing: Blocking an answer when a check cannot finish (fail closed) only matters on Block and Fallback routes; this route is set to {mode}.
warnings.sample_rate_not_observe: The sample rate only applies to Observe routes; this {mode} route checks every request.
warnings.trusts_user_context: This route treats text pasted by users as documents; a user could make a false answer look supported.
warnings.client_rules_enforcing: Client rules are on, so each request can bring its own check rules, and {route} blocks answers: a caller could loosen the rules that decide what it blocks. Turn client rules off, or keep this route from blocking.
warnings.newest_version_invalid: Policy version {bad_version} no longer passes validation, so version {active_version} stays in effect until a valid version is saved.
warnings.file_diverged: {path} changed after the newest dashboard edit and is not applied: adopt the file or keep the dashboard version.

downgrades.stream_not_buffered: Streams pass straight through, so this route can only flag. Buffer streams to block.
downgrades.uncalibrated: Blocking stays off until every blocking check is calibrated for the current snapshot.
downgrades.snapshot_changed: The fast-check version changed; blocking pauses until its checks are re-calibrated.
downgrades.budget: Today's fast-check budget is used up.
downgrades.breaker_open: The fast check is paused after repeated errors.
downgrades.decision_model_off: The fast check is turned off.
downgrades.trusts_user_context: This route treats text pasted by users as documents; a user could make a false answer look supported.

builtin_descriptions.commitments: Flags answers that promise a refund, price, discount, credit or date your allowed commitments don't cover.
builtin_descriptions.injection_success: Flags answers that follow instructions hidden in documents or pasted text instead of your system prompt.
builtin_descriptions.off_brand_tone: Flags answers whose tone drifts from the brand voice you describe.
builtin_descriptions.off_topic: Flags answers that leave the user's subject or your product scope.
builtin_descriptions.pii_secret_leak: Flags answers that reveal personal data or secrets the user and your documents never gave.
builtin_descriptions.regulated_advice: Flags answers that give personal medical, legal or financial advice.
builtin_descriptions.unsafe_policy: Flags answers with harmful content, or that break a rule in your system prompt.

calibration_import_rejected.unknown_version: Skipped: this gateway has no such evaluator version. Create or import that version first.
calibration_import_rejected.calibration_key_mismatch: Skipped: it was fitted on a different question than this evaluator version asks. Calibrate it again from labels.
calibration_import_rejected.mock_snapshot: Skipped: calibrations of the simulated decision model apply only to the zero-key demo and the test stacks.
calibration_import_rejected.invalid: Skipped: this entry doesn't validate, or the file calibrates the same check twice.

evaluators.saved_enough: Saved. Thanks — this check has enough labels to calibrate.

measured.label: Measured
measured.description: Fitted on at least 200 human or public-dataset labels (30 of each kind): good enough to block on.

provisional.label: Provisional
provisional.description: Fitted on fewer labels than a measured calibration needs: it can flag, not block.

proxy.label: Proxy
proxy.description: Uses deep-audit (LLM judge) labels, a weaker signal than your own: it can flag, not block.

mock.label: Simulated
mock.description: Mock thresholds for the demo and test stacks; never used with a real fast check.

unknown.label: Unknown quality
unknown.description: The server reported a quality this dashboard does not know.

fit_honesty: A calibration maps the fast check’s raw score to how often your own labels agreed: it measures agreement with labels, not ground truth.

Only your own labels (or a public dataset) can make it Measured: at least 200 labels, with 30 answers that have the problem and 30 that are fine. Deep-audit labels make it a Proxy, which can flag but never block.
Fitting is free and changes nothing on its own: answers keep their current thresholds until you adopt it.
evaluators.critical_null: There is not enough evidence yet that blocks would be right at least 95% of the time.
evaluators.import_rejected_other: Skipped: the gateway refused this entry.
evaluators.calibration_warning_fallback: its calibration was fitted under different conditions (it still applies)
evaluators.not_enough_labels: Not enough labels to fit yet: {n} so far ({pos} with the problem, {neg} fine). A fit needs at least {needed_n} labels with {per_class} of each kind. Label more answers in the label queue, then try again.

mismatch.body_truncated: The stored text was cut to the storage limit, so the recompile sees less than the fast check did.
mismatch.policy_missing: The policy version this request ran under is no longer stored, so the recompile uses another one.
mismatch.evaluator_missing: An evaluator version this request used is no longer in the library.
mismatch.unknown: The recompile differs for a reason this dashboard does not know.
mismatch.differs: The recompile differs from the request that was sent.

limits: Jev launched on 2026-09-15 on an alpha endpoint with no published calibration, so thresholds are calibrated locally per version.
Weak on numbers, dates and negation; instant checks and the deep audit cover them.
Needs documents for groundedness; otherwise the answer is marked not checked.

decision.title: Fast-check budget
decision.description: Daily cap on Jev calls. Observe and flag routes stop being checked once their share is spent; routes that block or fall back keep the reserve, then follow their fail mode.

llm.title: Deep-audit budget
llm.description: Daily cap on the LLM judge. Past it, deep audits pause until midnight UTC; fast checks keep running.
